parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Let your eyes close gently. <short pause> Feel the weight of your body, where it rests. <short pause> Your shoulders can soften now. <short pause> Let your jaw loosen... your tongue rest easy in your mouth. <long pause> There is nothing you need to hold. <long pause> Breathe in slowly through your nose... <short pause> and let that breath go. <long pause> Again, draw the air in gently... and release it with a quiet sigh. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The Shepherd knows where the still waters are. <short pause> He leads you there now... to a place of rest. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Picture yourself lying beside quiet water. <short pause> The surface is smooth as glass. <short pause> You can hear the faintest whisper of movement... water lapping gently at the shore. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Now bring your attention to the top of your head. <short pause> Let any tightness there simply fall away. <long pause> Move down to your forehead. <short pause> Smooth, and still. <long pause> Your eyes are closed, resting behind soft lids. <short pause> Let them sink a little deeper. <long pause> Your cheeks, your mouth, your chin... all quiet. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The water beside you does not rush, or strain. <short pause> It simply rests in its place. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Now feel your neck, the base of your skull. <short pause> Let the muscles there soften and lengthen. <long pause> Your shoulders can drop a little more. <short pause> There is no need to carry anything, just now. <long pause> Down through your arms... your elbows... your wrists. <short pause> All the way to your fingertips. <short pause> Let them rest open, and loose. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Breathe in gently. <short pause> And breathe out slowly. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Now turn your attention to your chest. <short pause> Feel it rise and fall, with each quiet breath. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The Shepherd is near. <short pause> He does not hurry you. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Move down to your belly, your lower back. <short pause> Let everything there release and soften. <long pause> Your hips, heavy and still. <short pause> Down through your thighs. <short pause> Your knees. <short pause> Your calves and shins. <short pause> All the way down to your ankles... and your feet. <long pause> Let your toes uncurl. <short pause> Every part of you is welcome to rest now. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You are lying by the still water. <short pause> The sky above is soft, and fading. <short pause> The air is cool and clean. <long pause> The Shepherd knows what you need. <short pause> He has brought you here... to restore your soul. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Listen now to these words. <long pause>
He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. <short pause> Psalm twenty-three, verse two. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: He makes you lie down in green pastures. <short pause> He leads you beside the still waters. <long pause> You do not have to make yourself peaceful. <short pause> He leads you to peace. <long pause> You do not have to earn this rest. <short pause> It is given. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Let your breath continue... slow, and steady. <long pause> The water beside you does not strive. <short pause> It receives the light of evening... and holds it gently. <long pause> You are held, just as gently, now. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: There is nothing left to do tonight. <long pause> The Shepherd watches over you. <long pause> Your body is heavy... and safe. <short pause> Your breath is quiet. <long pause> The still water reflects the last light of day. <long pause> And you are at rest beside it. <long pause>

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: May you sleep in the peace of the Shepherd who leads you. <long pause> May your soul be restored through the night. <long pause> May you wake tomorrow, held in the same gentle hands. <long pause>
